methodology.one_step_validation: Expanding-window rolling-origin: every prediction uses only observations before its target month.
methodology.recursive_validation: At each origin, fit once using data through the origin; recursively forecast the next 12 calendar months.
methodology.model_selection: Select model by mean origin-level MAE across the dedicated earlier selection origins; each origin contributes equally. Final holdout is never used for selection.
methodology.tuning: GridSearchCV + TimeSeriesSplit on the pre-validation period only.
methodology.final_holdout: Latest 12 calendar months are excluded from tuning and model selection; evaluate one-step and fixed-origin 12-step recursive forecasts separately.
methodology.prediction_intervals: Horizon-specific absolute-error quantiles. Model-selection origins and later calibration origins are separated; each horizon uses only its own recursive forecast errors. Calibration count, empirical coverage and interval width are reported per horizon.
methodology.interval_caveat: The configured minimum is a practical diagnostic threshold, not a guarantee. Rolling-origin errors can be serially dependent; calibration coverage is descriptive and does not guarantee future 95% coverage. Sparse samples are flagged and intervals are labeled empirical only.
methodology.forecast_date_policy: Publish 12 months after the later of the last observed month and the current calendar month; recursively bridge any elapsed but unobserved months without presenting them as future forecasts.
methodology.SO2: Inspect month-of-year seasonality and IQR/MAD outliers; compare raw Ridge, log1p Ridge and baselines; do not remove flagged outliers automatically.
methodology.units: All calculations/outputs are ug/m3; 1 mg/m3 = 1000 ug/m3. Auto unit detection is a scale heuristic, not proof of source units.
methodology.MAPE: MAPE excludes near-zero actual values; interpret MAE, RMSE, sMAPE and WAPE alongside it.
